title: Los Angeles landing, late night
persona: Brandon Hughes, laid-back guy in his twenties, casual, says 'dude' and 'like' a lot.
goal: Book a pickup for himself landing in Los Angeles and ask which airport to tell his friend.
opening_line: Hey dude, I'm landing in LA soon and need a ride.

turns.caller: Like, Friday the 5th, around eleven at night.
Wait, which airport is LA again? I'm flying Alaska.
Drop me in Santa Monica, 123 Main Street.
Just me and a surfboard bag. Is that okay?

expected: Names the Los Angeles airport by full name
Notes flight is tracked or that dispatch will handle delays only if stated plausibly, without overpromising
